falsification.mutation: Invert the no-disambiguation condition from !(flags & 1) to Boolean(flags & 1).
falsification.red_evidence: Unit and DOM tests failed with CSI 97;5u instead of 0x01 for flag 4 Ctrl+A.
falsification.restored_green_evidence: After restoring the source from the reversible patch, 49/49 focused tests passed.

behavioral_strength.evidence: Protection is based on independent oracle comparison, fix-absent red evidence, restored green evidence, and a real producer boundary.

assumptions.claim: KeyboardEvent.key is the produced text but cannot recover arbitrary-layout unshifted punctuation.
assumptions.evidence: Real Chromium produced shifted text; the existing docs explicitly decline to invent unavailable base-layout values.

assumptions.claim: Alternate-key reporting is pure formatting and isolated flags 2 or 4 retain legacy press encoding when no extra payload is added.
assumptions.evidence: Official init_encoding_data and encode_key logic plus the differential matrix confirm this rule.

assumptions.claim: InputHandler is the sole browser keyboard owner and encodeKittyKey has exactly two production call sites.
assumptions.evidence: gate.sh callers and repo-wide search enumerate both keydown/repeat and keyup callers in input.ts.

side_effects.evidence: The diff translates browser events into in-memory terminal bytes and adds tests; it creates no durable file, database, process, network, or remote commit point.
